generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
The Tenderer must be Registered in BWSSB or registration equivalent with KPWD/CPWD etc.,and shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in currency
All the terms and conditions are as per bid document
Bid capacity has to be uploaded
The Form of tender as per the proforma available in KW-I should be duly filled and uploaded in the e-procurement portal as a part of tender document which is mandatory.
Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN No. to be submitted.
Amount put to tender is excluding GST. Rates quoted shall be excluding GST

Assessed available tender capacity should be (AN2.5-B) greater than 20.48 Lakhs, wherein A is Maximum value of Civil Engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is Number of years B is Value of on-going works
DI pipes will be supplied by Department as per schedule A
